characters.summary: Maximus is a Roman general turned gladiator who excels in brutal melee combat, tactical leadership, and throwing weapons. He relies on exceptional physical conditioning, peerless swordplay, and unmatched combat experience.

mechanisms: Heavy leather and metal gladiator armor

weaknesses: Vulnerable to severe physical blood loss and mortal wounds
Subject to emotional vulnerability regarding the murder of his family
limitations: Human physical limits; cannot survive lethal poisoning or mortal wounds indefinitely

sources.supports: Fictional context, military background, and character fate in Gladiator

notableResults.note: Maximus kills Commodus in the Colosseum while suffering from a mortal poison wound inflicted prior to the match.
Defeated Tigris in the Colosseum arena.

characters.summary: Morpheus is a master martial artist, tactician, and freedom fighter inside and outside the Matrix. He wields firearms, heavy melee weapons, and martial arts with supernatural proficiency enabled by digital simulation physics.
weaknesses: Physical body in the real world remains vulnerable while jacked into the Matrix
Subject to physical damage if killed inside the simulation
limitations: Dependent on being connected to the Matrix to manipulate simulated physics

sources.supports: Abilities, role as captain of the Nebuchadnezzar, and combat skills within the Matrix

notableResults.note: Captured by Agents after a protracted rooftop and highway fight while defending Neo.

characters.summary: Ms. Perkins is a professional, cold-blooded assassin who utilizes handguns, silenced firearms, and brutal close-quarters combat techniques to dispatch targets.
weaknesses: Standard human limitations; vulnerable to firearms and blunt trauma
limitations: Relies entirely on standard conventional weaponry and human physical attributes

sources.supports: Character details and role as a Continental assassin

notableResults.note: Ambushed John Wick but was ultimately executed for breaking Continental rules.

characters.summary: Murron is a civilian villager from medieval Scotland skilled in rural survival, stone throwing, and evasion against occupying English soldiers.
weaknesses: Lacks military training, armor, or advanced weaponry
limitations: Ordinary human capabilities with no supernatural or heavily armored defense

sources.supports: Murron's role and execution by English soldiers in Braveheart

notableResults.note: Captured and publicly executed by local occupying forces.

characters.summary: Nathan Algren is a disillusioned American Civil War veteran and master swordsman who adopts traditional samurai warfare, excelling in katana combat, horseback riding, and tactical defense.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to superior numbers of modern firearms and artillery
limitations: Human stamina and standard physical durability

sources.supports: Algren's military background and samurai training

notableResults.note: Fought alongside samurai rebels in major tactical engagements against imperial forces.

characters.summary: Neo is The One, possessing reality-warping capabilities within the Matrix simulation, including flight, telekinetic stopping of projectiles, superhuman speed, and immense martial arts mastery.

mechanisms: Invulnerability to standard simulated trauma once awakened as The One

weaknesses: Real-world physical body remains vulnerable if disconnected or attacked outside
Agent programs can pose direct threats if caught off guard
limitations: Powers are native to the simulated digital environment of the Matrix

sources.supports: Abilities of The One, flight, and reality manipulation within the Matrix

notableResults.note: Destroyed Agent Smith from the inside after fully realizing his powers as The One.

campaignTags.claim: Neo flies freely through the skies within the Matrix simulation.

characters.summary: Nux is a fanatic War Boy driver who utilizes heavily modified vehicular combat, firearms, and explosive thundersticks with suicidal abandon.
weaknesses: Suffers from chronic physical frailty ("half-life" condition requiring blood bags)
limitations: Dependent on vehicles and mechanical equipment for mobility and combat effectiveness

sources.supports: Nux's role as a War Boy and vehicular combat feats

notableResults.note: Sacrificed his vehicle to block a mountain pass, defeating the pursuers at the cost of his life.

characters.summary: O-Ren Ishii, also known as Cottonmouth, is a supreme assassin and leader of the Yakuza, wielding a master-crafted katana with lethal precision and lethal bodyguard support.
weaknesses: Standard human vulnerability to sharp-force trauma and fatal blade wounds
limitations: Human physical limits and vulnerability in single combat

sources.supports: O-Ren Ishii's status as a master assassin and duel in the House of Blue Leaves

notableResults.note: Defeated and killed by Beatrix Kiddo in a snowy Japanese garden duel.

characters.continuity: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005 film)
characters.summary: Peter Pevensie is High King of Narnia, commanding armies and fighting with a magical steel sword and shield against mythical creatures and enemy soldiers.
weaknesses: Human physical vulnerability when unarmored or overwhelmed by magical beasts
limitations: Relies on physical prowess and standard medieval weaponry

sources.supports: Peter's role as High King, gift of sword and shield, and battle feats

notableResults.citation: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005)
notableResults.note: Defeated the general of the White Witch's army in single combat during the Battle of Beruna.

campaignTags.claim: Wields Rhindon, a magically enhanced sword given by Father Christmas.
